metadata.title: The Wonder Of Positive Crankcase Ventilation
metadata.description:
Up until the advent of the PCV valve in 1963, automobile engines were free to dribble and puke the contents of their crankcases all over the landscape at will. This simple device changed all that while essentially doubling the life of those engines in the process.
Here's how the PCV works, and a look at the primitive Road Draft Tube systems that they replaced.
Subscribe to Kiwi Classics and Customs here: @kiwiclassicsandcustoms9160
